title: Colts backup QB battle heads to split decision after preseason finale

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts backup QB battle heads to split decision after preseason finale
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts closed the preseason with a 25-16 loss to the Detroit Lions inside Lucas Oil Stadium, giving both quarterbacks vying for the backup job one final quarter in Saturday’s showcase to prove why they deserve to suit up with the horseshoe on Sundays. Detroit certainly didn’t make things easier and controlled the finale […]
